At first they were admiring, then disappointed. 2 restaurant visits
Apr 2026 • Family
Been to this restaurant twice. The first time I really liked the ray with capers, it was perfectly cooked, as well as delicious mussels as an appetizer.
But I didn't like Vietnamese crab soup at all, even though the waiter said it was delicious. Fried seafood rice is medium. Freshly squeezed juices are slightly diluted.
For the second time, inspired by stingrays, they ordered tom yams, shrimp paste and biscuit sauce, seafood salad and fried beef rice, and tiramisu.
And after that visit, it became clear that we would not come here again. Mediocre paste, salad and rice with beef, tom pit - very sweet, not canonical)))) And tiramisu - dry and tasteless, unfortunately. Not client-oriented. The price tag is higher than average in Muyn/Fantiet.

One of the best restaurants in the resort. Maybe the best. We thought we'd eat seafood only, but in Vietnam, they make poor quality, sometimes just awful... so we got to this restaurant on recommendation. The steaks are awesome, and there's a lot of good stuff. The cocktails are good! It's hard to find a good Pina Colada in Vietnam, they make a good one. We were here three times in two weeks, for there was nowhere else to go for a delicious dinner ... were in many establishments - that is the first place. Opposite also the restaurant is kept by Europeans - also good, but more expensive and more sniffy..but fondan chocolate is the most delicious! in this delicious, on relaxation and a little cheaper))))
